detail.longDescription: My System 1 brain instantly blamed the AI model when my pipeline crashed. "The LLM is just dumb." But stepping back with System 2 analytical thinking, I realized the truth: I’d strapped an F1 engine to a skateboard. The fix wasn't a new prompt. It was Harness Engineering—building durable state, context management, and strict verification around the model. Clever models need dependable systems. Learn to break the system. # HarnessEngineering # AgenticAI # SystemsThinking # SoftwareDev
